articles.summary: SMA, a leading provider of solar solutions, partners with Enode to help energy companies connect and optimize SMA assets through a single, reliable integration. As households adopt more distributed energy resources, including solar panels, home batteries, electric vehicles and heat pumps, energy companies need reliable ways to connect these assets and deliver seamless customer experiences. Through this partnership, energy retailers, utilities and energy platforms using Enode, can integrate SMA-connected assets into energy products and flexibility programs without building and maintaining their own integration.
articles.title: SMA partners with Enode to unlock solar and battery flexibility for the next grid
